hero.title: Nuteƒewɔwɔ
hero.lead: IATF wɔa dɔ le dutoƒo le ɖoɖo nu. Woŋlɔa ɖoɖo ƒe nyametsotsowo, ɖoɖo ƒe tɔtrɔwo, dziɖuɖu ƒe tɔtrɔ, kple dɔwɔwɔ ƒe gazazãwo ɖe dutoƒo teƒewo. axa sia yɔ afisi nuŋlɔɖi ƒomevi ɖesiaɖe le kple alesi woaxlẽe.

items: Dɔa ŋuti nyametsotsowo wɔwɔ. Woŋlɔa nyametsotso siwo ku ɖe wo xɔxɔ, wo dzadzraɖo ɖe nuŋlɔɖigbalẽwo me, kple wo gbugbɔ ɖoɖo ɖe dɔwo ŋu la ɖi abe nya siwo ŋu wotrɔ asi le la ene le agbalẽdzraɖoƒea, eye woƒoa wo nu ƒu ɖe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe si le dutoƒo la me. agbalẽdzraɖoƒeaWò ya bu eŋu kpɔ ko.

Bia nyatakakawo. Public request records le IATF GitHub organization, le website sia dzi, alo wo kple eveawo siaa. Records ate ŋu aƒo nu ƒu, atrɔ asi le wo ŋu, alo awɔ asitɔtrɔ le original request la ŋu ale be woate ŋu adzro accessibility ƒe hiahiãa me eye womagatsɔ ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyatakaka siwo mehiã o afia o. Discord decisions are summarized into the public record when they affect a project or governance decision. Request records are excluded from search engine indexing where technically practical. View records: first publication request pending.
Kodewo le tɔtrɔm. Xexeame ƒe tɔtrɔ ɖesiaɖe nye dukɔmevi ƒe adzɔgbeɖeɖe le agbalẽdzraɖoƒe si ŋu nyaa ku ɖo me. Kpɔ IATF GitHub habɔbɔWò ya bu eŋu kpɔ ko.

Dziɖuɖu ƒe tɔtrɔwo. Wo léa ŋku ɖe nyatakaka siwo ŋu wotrɔ asi le le dziɖulanyenye ŋuti nyatakakadzraɖoƒea la ŋu ne wole asi trɔm le wo ŋu le Internet dzi. IATF ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe Ŋkuléle Ðe Ŋkuɖodziawo Ŋu nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe nuŋlɔɖi le GitHub dzi.
Dɔwɔƒe ƒe gazazãwo. IATF léa dɔwɔnawo ƒe gazazãwo dzi ɖe te eye wòŋlɔa ga siwo wozãna ɖe dugã me mɔ̃wo ŋu la ɖi. Tso ƒe 2022 me la, ga siwo zãm wole la nyea domen-ŋkɔwo.
Ðoɖowɔɖi ŋuti nuŋlɔɖiwo. Notes from any coordinated review or decision live in GitHub Nyatakakawo le agbalẽdzraɖoƒea view Dzeɖoɖowo le IATF ƒe nyatakakadzraɖoƒe agbalẽdzraɖoƒea.

paragraphs: IATF wɔa ɖoɖo ɖe eƒe dukɔmeviwo ƒe nuɖoanyiwo ŋu be woaganye gã o. Tso ƒe 2022 me la, domen ŋkɔwo koŋue va zua dɔwɔnawo ƒe gazazã vevitɔ. Wozãa xɔxɔdɔwɔƒe siwo me womezãa ga le o alo esiwo me ga mele o le afisiwo wòanya wɔ le.
Menye akɔntabubu si ŋu wowɔ numekuku le ye nuŋlɔɖi sia nye o. Enye mɔ̃ɖaŋudɔ siwo wozãna tsɔ kpɔa IATF dzi la ƒe dɔwɔwɔ ƒe gazazãwo ŋuti nuŋlɔɖi si le gaglãgbe.
operatingCosts.footnote: Woate ŋu azã nuŋɔŋlɔwo le nu siwo woxɔ ŋu alo woata wo ne wotrɔ asi le wo ŋu vɔ megbe. Ame ŋutɔ ƒe adrɛswo, fexexlẽ ŋuti nyatakakawo, kple nyatakaka siwo mehiã o siwo ku ɖe ga ŋu la menyea amewo ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo ƒe akpa aɖeke o.

header.title: Nu si menye ame sia ame tɔ o

paragraphs: Womeɖea nyatakaka aɖewo ɖe go le amewo ƒe nuŋlɔɖiwo me o le susu aɖewo ta:
items: Ame siwo le asi kpem ɖe dɔa ŋu ƒe kadodo ŋuti nyatakakawo.
Wozãa agbalẽ siwo woŋlɔ ɖe wo nɔewo me be woatsɔ aɖe biabia aɖe me na wo hafi woalɔ̃ ɖe edzi, agbe edzi, alo aƒo nya ta le eme.
Ame ŋutɔ ƒe adrɛswo, telefon xexlẽdzesiwo, kple ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyatakaka siwo mehiã o.
Nu sia nu si ate ŋu ana woanya ame aɖe si zãa mɔ̃ɖaŋunu siwo kpena ɖe ame ŋu evɔ eƒe mɔɖeɖe meli o.
Raw Discord dzeɖoɖowo, negbe ɖe woɖoe koŋ tsɔ gbedasi aɖe yi dɔdzikpɔlawo ƒe nuŋlɔɖi me ko hafi.

header.title: Dziɖuɖumegãwo ƒe ɖoɖowo dzie nuŋlɔɖi siawo nɔ te ɖo

paragraphs: Ne èdi be yease alesi woxɔa dɔwo, dzraa wo ɖo, alo tsɔa dɔ bubuwo naa amewoe gɔme la, ke xlẽ dziɖuɖua ƒe axa.
